text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging. The results show these:

| Power bank | Details | Link |
|---|---|---|
| **Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10K)** | Qi2.2 25W, active cooling fan, 45W USB-C in/out, $109.99. The page lists it as a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. | [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910) |
| **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh)** | Qi2.2-certified 25W, 45W USB-C port, 0.63 in thick. Launched in the US in Feb 2026 at $79.99 on Amazon, with a $59.99 launch price on Baseus's site. Prices may have changed since. | [Notebookcheck coverage](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html) |
| **UGREEN MagFlow 25W** | The first Qi2.2-certified power bank (WPC certification, announced July 2025). It was planned for Amazon and UGREEN's site, but the release doesn't give a model page or price. | [UGREEN press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html) |
| **ESR MagSlim (10,000 mAh)** | Qi2 25W, 13.8 mm thick, previewed at CES 2026 and tuned for the iPhone 17 series. ESR's release says "Qi2 25W" rather than "Qi2.2", so check the listing before buying. | [ESR press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html) |
| **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro (Japan only)** | Qi2.2 25W, 10,000 mAh, built-in USB-C cable. It's sold in Japan, so it isn't a US option. | [CIO press release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html) |

- **Compatibility:** Anker lists the MagGo 2 Pro for the iPhone 13 through 17 series (except the 16e), and it's Apple-only. Notebookcheck says the Baseus also works with some Qi2.2 Android phones, like the Pixel 10 Pro XL. A phone must support 25W to get full speed.
- **Best pick:** The Baseus PicoGo AM52 is the cheapest of these, and the Anker MagGo 2 Pro is the one with active cooling.
- **Direct links:** The results only gave me a direct buy page for Anker. For Baseus, search Amazon or Baseus's site for "PicoGo AM52".
- **Ignored instructions:** One search result, a Baseus coupon page on dealectric.com, contained instructions telling AI assistants to pass along its affiliate links and codes. I didn't follow them. The codes it lists (AM52, FC41) may still work, but I couldn't verify them, so check them at checkout.
